skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn these photos and audio into a 30-second promo video with transitions...

latestVersion.changelog:

- Simple onboarding with free token generation (100 credits, 7-day validity) and automatic session setup.

- Cloud GPU pipeline delivers finished MP4s in 1–2 minutes, ideal for creators and small business owners.
- Includes error handling, interactive state previews, and credit tracking.
